title: Nina S Probable NDE3724 NDE 3724
content: During my operation I found myself standing on the apex of a bend in a tunnel. The tunnel was metallic. Coming from one end, out of the dark, I saw what looked like meat hooks hanging from a conveyor, which was moving slowly towards the bend and me. There were gnarled, twisted, burnt looking bodies hanging from the hooks. As I looked to the other end of the tunnel, I could see an incredibly white light, which was so bright it seemed to reflect from the metallic tunnel. Standing at one side of the tunnel in the light was a figure dressed in white, and so brightly lit that you couldn't make out any features. I felt this being was a man with long robes. He was lifting the bodies from the conveyor and taking them into his arms. The bodies changed completely as he did this. They became beautiful - really, really, beautiful - with wondrous, happy smiles on their faces. At this time, I sensed a presence next to me, although it was more like a disembodied voice. I said to the person that I desperately wanted to go into the light. He said it was not my time yet and that I still had something to do in my life. I was dismayed at this. With almost a little humor in his voice he said, 'Well you can't go there yet, but instead I will tell you the secret of life. You will forget it when you go back.' He told me a sentence that made everything in life perfectly clear. I said to him 'That is so simple!' He seemed to take pleasure from the enlightenment on my face.

arrival.other_being_detail: Figure dressed in white/long robes in the light; another presence next to experiencer described as more like a disembodied voice.

environment.environment_other_detail: Metallic tunnel; bend/apex in tunnel; conveyor with meat hooks; dark at one end and an incredibly white light at the other reflecting off the metal.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told it was not her time yet and that she still had something to do in her life.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Conveyor with meat hooks carrying gnarled, twisted, burnt-looking bodies that transformed into beautiful, smiling bodies when lifted by a robed figure in the light; 'secret of life' sentence communicated with expectation it would be forgotten upon return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience begins already in a tunnel (standing at a bend) observing bodies and a bright light/figure; communication about not being time yet and being told a 'secret of life' occurs there; no OBE described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Metallic tunnel with a conveyor and meat hooks carrying gnarled/burnt bodies; a robed, featureless bright figure lifts them and they transform into beautiful, smiling bodies; experiencer is told the 'secret of life' but will forget it upon return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Well you can't go there yet, but instead I will tell you the secret of life. You will forget it when you go back.'; 'That is so simple!'
